title: COLO829 Somatic Pipeline Run Manifest
description: Auto-generated per pipeline run at results/provenance/run_manifest.json. Captures everything needed to reproduce or audit a run's results, and to know exactly what a given results/ directory was produced against.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run, e.g. UUID or timestamp-based slug.

pipeline_git_commit.description: Full git SHA of the pipeline repo at the commit this run was executed from. Dirty working tree should be flagged explicitly (e.g. suffix '-dirty').

run_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of run start.

profile.description: Which nextflow.config profile this run used (dev = chr21 + melanoma gene loci interval; full = whole genome).

samples.description: Input sample identifiers and their source accessions.

build.description: e.g. 'GRCh38.d1.vd1' or 'GRCh38 primary assembly' — must match the build the PoN/gnomAD resources were built against.

fasta_source.description: Download URL for the reference FASTA.

tool_versions.description: Exact version string for every tool in the DAG, keyed by module.

gatk.description: e.g. '4.5.0.0' — covers MarkDuplicates, GetPileupSummaries, CalculateContamination, Mutect2, LearnReadOrientationModel, FilterMutectCalls.

resources.description: External reference resources and their exact versions/URLs at time of use.

version.description: e.g. COSMIC SBS reference set v3.4

lineage_caveat.description: Explicit note on whether the truth set derives from the same COLO829 sequencing/preparation as the input FASTQs, per the plan's Phase 0 requirement.

containers.description: Every container image used, with exact tag and digest.

digest.description: sha256 digest for exact reproducibility, since tags can be repointed.

qc_thresholds.description: Configurable QC gates actually in effect for this run (from conf/resources.config).
